description: This file is a script executed after the installation of a software package. It manages the recovery and installation of bundled plugin dependencies for an OpenClaw project. The script discovers runtime dependencies for bundled plugins, checks for missing dependencies, and attempts to install them via npm. It also provides utility functions to handle environment setup and determine if the current directory is a source checkout root.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file at the given path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs a path to a dependency's package.json inside node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Collects dependencies and optional dependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies for bundled plugins in the extensions directory, returning a list of dependency objects.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates a clean environment object suitable for npm install, removing global configuration variables.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Determines if the current directory is a source checkout root by checking for presence of specific directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Decides whether to run the post-install script based on environment variables and directory structure.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function that manages the post-install steps: checking dependencies, installing missing ones, and logging outcomes.
